title: Star exclusion uses a cross instead of the configured rectangle
description:
indigo_raw_utils.c:3037: excluded rectangle rejects stars where x is within its span OR y is within its span. This excludes an entire cross rather than only the configured rectangle; imager and guider both call this helper with rectangular exclusion dimensions. Next: Combine the two axis-membership tests with AND; verify stars inside rectangle, same x outside y, same y outside x, outside both.
